mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_doc ( target_type, target_id, search_text, status, published_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{searchText}, #{status}, #{publishedAt}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE search_text = VALUES(search_text), status = VALUES(status), published_at = VALUES(published_at), updated_at = NOW()

choose.otherwise:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 1 AS targetType, sd.target_id AS targetId, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.title, ''), LEFT(p.content, 40)) AS title, IF(CHAR_LENGTH(p.content) > 120, CONCAT(LEFT(p.content, 120), '...'), p.content) AS summary, IFNULL(p.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(p.comment_count, 0) AS commentCount, IFNULL(p.view_count, 0) AS viewCount, sd.published_at AS publishedAt FROM search_doc sd JOIN post p ON p.id = sd.target_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sd.target_type = 1 AND sd.status = 1 AND MATCH(sd.search_text) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS targetType, sd.target_id AS targetId, a.title AS title, IF(CHAR_LENGTH(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.location, a.summary)) > 120, CONCAT(LEFT(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.location, a.summary), 120), '...'), CONCAT_WS(' ', a.location, a.summary)) AS summary, IFNULL(a.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(a.comment_count, 0) AS commentCount, IFNULL(a.view_count, 0) AS viewCount, sd.published_at AS publishedAt FROM search_doc sd JOIN activity a ON a.id = sd.target_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sd.target_type = 2 AND sd.status = 1 AND MATCH(sd.search_text) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ) t
t.publishedAt < #{lastPublishedAt} OR (t.publishedAt = #{lastPublishedAt} AND t.targetId < #{lastId})
ORDER BY t.publishedAt DESC, t.targetId DESC LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.select: SELECT sd.target_type AS targetType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM search_doc sd WHERE sd.status = 1 AND MATCH(sd.search_text) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) GROUP BY sd.target_type ORDER BY sd.target_type
